```sql
WITH iade_sonucleri AS (
    SELECT siparis_id, urun_id, SUM(adet) AS iade_adet
    FROM iadeler
    GROUP BY siparis_id, urun_id
),
kalem_odemeleri AS (
    SELECT sk.urun_id, u.ad AS urun_adi, sk.birim_fiyat AS birim_fiyat,
           sk.adet - COALESCE(i.iade_adet, 0) AS net_adet_kalem
    FROM siparis_kalemleri sk
    JOIN urunler u ON u.id = sk.urun_id
    LEFT JOIN iade_sonucleri i
        ON i.siparis_id = sk.siparis_id AND i.urun_id = sk.urun_id
)
SELECT k.urun_adi,
       SUM(k.net_adet_kalem)                             AS net_adet,
       ROUND(SUM(k.net_adet_kalem * birim_fiyat), 2)     AS net_ciro
FROM kalem_odemeleri k
GROUP BY k.urun_id, k.urun_adi
ORDER BY net_ciro DESC, urun_adi ASC
LIMIT 5;
```

|---|---|---|
| Laptop | 32 | 980800.00 |
| Kulaklık | 58 | 103770.00 |
| Klavye | 37 | 43200.00 |
| Dambıl | 51 | 38775.00 |
| Tava | 40 | 36855.00 |

WITH kalemler AS (
    SELECT sk.siparis_id,
           sk.urun_id,
           u.ad                       AS urun_adi,
           COALESCE(sk.adet, 0)       AS satilan,
           COALESCE(i.iade_adet, 0)   AS iade_edilen,
           sk.birim_fiyat
    FROM siparis_kalemleri sk
    JOIN urunler u ON u.id = sk.urun_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT siparis_id,
               urun_id,
               SUM(adet) AS iade_adet
        FROM iadeler
        GROUP BY siparis_id, urun_id
    ) i ON i.siparis_id = sk.siparis_id AND i.urun_id = sk.urun_id
),
odeme_kalemleri AS (
    SELECT k.*
    FROM kalemler k
    WHERE k.satilan > 0
),
saf_iadeler AS (
    SELECT r.siparis_id,
           u.id            AS urun_id,
           u.ad            AS urun_adi,
           -r.adet         AS satilan,
          r.adet           AS iade_edilen,
           0.0             AS birim_fiyat
    FROM iadeler r
    JOIN urunler u ON u.id = r.urun_id
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM siparis_kalemleri sk
        WHERE sk.siparis_id = r.siparis_id
          AND sk.urun_id   = r.urun_id
          AND sk.adet > 0
    )
)
SELECT u.ad AS urun_adi,
       (SUM(CASE WHEN k.satilan > 0 THEN k.satilan - iad.iade_adet END) +
        COALESCE(si.saf_iade, 0))                                    AS net_adet,
       ROUND(SUM(k.net_ciro), 2)                                    AS net_ciro
FROM urunler u
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT urun_id,
           SUM(satilan - iade_edilen) * birim_fiyat AS net_ciro
    FROM odeme_kalemleri
    GROUP BY urun_id
) k ON k.urun_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT siparis_id,
           urun_id,
           SUM(adet) AS iade_adet
    FROM iadeler
    GROUP BY siparis_id, urun_id
) iad ON iad.siparis_id IS NULL   -- placeholder, replaced below
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT urun_id,
           -SUM(adet) AS saf_iade
    FROM saf_iadeler
    GROUP BY urun_id
) si ON si.urun_id = u.id
GROUP BY u.ad
ORDER BY net_ciro DESC, urun_adi ASC
LIMIT 5;
